description: This file declares functions for serializing and deserializing JSON data with protection via TpmResourceManager, specifically for secure environment management in the Cuttlefish project.

methods.name: WriteProtectedJsonToFile
methods.description: Writes a JSON value to a file, protected by TpmResourceManager.

methods.name: ReadProtectedJsonFromFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON value from a file, ensuring protection with TpmResourceManager.
